title: Harden x509 appendix verifier semantics
description: Codereview findings (kimi-k3, security+edge passes) against spec/appendix-x509-cert-profile.md created in viku.1; these change verifier-behavior requirements (§8): (1) the key-to-address binding check (§8 step 4) compares only the lower 64 bits — MUST recompute the full 16-byte native address ([0x02]+SHA-512(pubkey)[0:7]+IID) and compare all 128 bits, otherwise a cert with arbitrary upper bytes passes while attesting an address the node does not own; (2) wholesale chain replacement has no freshness ordering — a node re-issued a reduced cert can re-present its older still-valid chain and roll verifiers back (last-presented-wins); add a replace-only-if-newer rule (e.g. strictly later notBefore/notAfter, reject older chains); (3) role extension is not scoped to authorized anchors — any chain to ANY configured trust anchor (incl. the optional public default CA) would satisfy lichen:relay=true by default, promoting every identity anchor to a mesh-wide forwarding grantor and contradicting the gateway-local lichen:relay local-fact model (06-security.md 8.13.1); add normative text that role-bearing anchors MUST be separately configured and that absence of role assertion must not be read as leaf.
